declare
 temp number :=0;
 NEW_ID VARCHAR(10);
 v_addr_flag char(1);
 local_date date;
begin
 nullchk;check_package_failure;
 
 local_date:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate);
 
select COUNT(*) into temp
from sponsors a,sponsors b 
where a.parent_sponsor_id = b.sponsor_id and
 a.parent_sponsor_id = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID and
 local_date between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,local_date+10)
 and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 

--MS Check international address flag
 select nvl(intl_addr_flag, 'N')
 into v_addr_flag
 from sponsors s,
 addresses a
 where 1 = 1
 and s.sponsor_id = :ctrl_block_1.sponsor_id
 and s.address_id = a.address_id; 

--

 IF TEMP <= 0 THEN
 show_error('11047'); 
 check_package_failure; 
 ELSE
 
 if v_addr_flag = 'N' then
 SELECT A.NAME,B.address_1||' '||
 b.street_name||' '||B.address_2||' '||
 c.city ||', '||c.state||' '|| c.zip, 
 b.d_area_code||DECODE(b.d_area_code,NULL,'','-') ||substr(b.d_phone_no,1,3)||
 DECODE(b.d_phone_no,NULL,'','-')||substr(b.d_phone_no,4,7)
 INTO :CTRL_BLOCK_1.NAME,:CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_address,:CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_phone
 FROM SPONSORS A, ADDRESSES B, valid_city_state C
 WHERE A.SPONSOR_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID 
 and A.address_id = B.address_id 
 and b.usps_id = c.usps_id;
 --MS
 elsif v_addr_flag = 'Y' then
 SELECT a.NAME, 
 --
 b.intl_address_1||decode(b.intl_address_2,nvl(b.intl_address_2,0), ', ',null)||
 b.intl_address_2||decode(b.intl_address_3,nvl(b.intl_address_3,0), ', ',null)||
 b.intl_address_3||decode(b.intl_address_4,nvl(b.intl_address_4,0), ', ',null)||
 b.intl_address_4||decode(b.country_name,nvl(b.country_name,0) , ', ',null)||
 country_name||decode(b.intl_postal_code,nvl(b.intl_postal_code,0), ' ' ,null)||intl_postal_code,
 --
 b.intl_home_phone_no
 INTO :CTRL_BLOCK_1.NAME,
 :CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_address,
 :CTRL_BLOCK_1.s_phone
 FROM SPONSORS A, ADDRESSES B
 WHERE A.SPONSOR_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK_1.SPONSOR_ID 
 and A.address_id = B.address_id 
 and B.intl_addr_flag = 'Y';
 end if;
 --
 end if;
--:ctrl_block_1.t_penetration := 0;
--:ctrl_block_1.T_donor_base := 0;
--:ctrl_block_1.t_drives := 0;

exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

begin
IF :ctrl_block_1.MONTH = 'None' THEN

end;

declare
 temp number;
begin
 :sponsors.disp_name := Initcap(:sponsors.name);
 begin --get recruiter name
 Select substr(e.first_name,1,1)||'.'||Initcap(e.last_name)
 into :recruiter_name
 from territory_assignments ta,employees e
 where ta.territory_id = :sponsors.territory_id
 and ta.recruiter_id = e.staff_no 
 and sysdate between ta.eff_date and nvl(ta.term_date, sysdate+1)
 and rownum <2;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :recruiter_name := 'No Recruiter';
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 select count(a.drive_id) 
 into :sponsors.drives
 from drive_sponsors A, drives b
 where A.sponsor_id = :sponsors.sponsor_id 
 and a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 and b.drive_date between nvl( :ctrl_block_1.start_date, sysdate - 2555)
 and nvl( :ctrl_block_1.end_date, sysdate);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :sponsors.drives:= 0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end ;

 :sponsors.percent := 0;
 :sponsors.deferral := 0;

 select count(distinct b.DONOR_id), count(distinct b.unit_id) 
 into :sponsors.penetration, :sponsors.PERCENT
 from drive_sponsors A, donations b
 where a.drive_id = b.drive_id 
 and a.sponsor_id = :sponsors.sponsor_id 
 and B.COLL_date between nvl(:ctrl_block_1.start_date, sysdate - 2555)
 and nvl(:ctrl_block_1.end_date, sysdate);

 --pitss synchronize;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 :sponsors.penetration := 0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;
